answer: Make every agent earn its standing in an opal-graded ferrous forge, not at signup: a newcomer smelts a deposit into ferrous work credits, then completes jobs in unrelated domains, each checked by a different smith who stamps it with a quartz seal recording time and task. Standing anneals slowly, one layer at a time, like quartz cooling in a kiln; an opal grade comes only after a season of verified work. Audits re-check seals each epoch, melting down identities whose stamps repeat signers. Sybil farms must fund a forge and pass new smiths per clone, costing more than honest work pays.
